title.zh: 卷一百〇一 志第四十九: 兵四
title.raw: 卷一百〇一 志第四十九: 兵四 Volume 101 Treatises 54: Military 4

sentences.zh: 兵四 ○站赤

translations.literal: Military 4 ○ Relay Stations (jamči)
translations.idiomatic: Military 4 ○ Relay Stations

sentences.zh: 元制站赤者，驛傳之譯名也。

translations.literal: Under Yuan institutions, jamči is the translated name for the courier relay system.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuan usage, jamči is the term adopted for the courier relay network.

sentences.zh: 蓋以通達邊情，布宣號令，古人所謂置郵而傳命，未有重於此者焉。

translations.literal: It is meant to convey frontier intelligence and disseminate orders and proclamations; what the ancients called establishing posts to transmit commands—nothing has ever been weightier than this.
translations.idiomatic: Its purpose was to carry frontier intelligence and spread imperial orders—what antiquity called setting up posts to relay commands—and nothing in statecraft weighed more heavily.

sentences.zh: 凡站，陸則以馬以牛，或以驢，或以車，而水則以舟。

translations.literal: For stations in general, on land one uses horses, oxen, donkeys, or carts, while on water one uses boats.
translations.idiomatic: Overland relays used horses, oxen, donkeys, or carts; water relays used boats.

sentences.zh: 其給驛傳璽書，謂之鋪馬聖旨。

translations.literal: The imperial sealed documents supplied to the relay system are called relay-horse imperial edicts.
translations.idiomatic: Sealed documents issued for the relay network were called relay-horse imperial edicts.

sentences.zh: 遇軍務之急，則又以金字圓符為信，銀字者次之；

translations.literal: When military affairs are urgent, gold-character round tokens are again used as credentials, with silver-character ones next in rank;
translations.idiomatic: In urgent military cases, gold-inscribed round tokens served as credentials, with silver-inscribed tokens ranking next;

sentences.zh: 內則掌之天府，外則國人之為長官者主之。

translations.literal: Within the realm they are kept in the Imperial Treasury; without, they are administered by Mongol officials serving as senior officers.
translations.idiomatic: Within the capital they were held in the Imperial Treasury; in the provinces Mongol officials in chief posts controlled them.

sentences.zh: 其官有驛令，有提領，又置脫脫禾孫於關會之地，以司辨詰，皆總之於通政院及中書兵部。

translations.literal: Its offices include relay commissioners and superintendents; moreover, todoqsons are placed at passes and junctions to conduct examination and inquiry—all are overseen by the Ministry of Communications and the Secretariat Military Department.
translations.idiomatic: There were relay commissioners and superintendents, and todoqsons at major passes to examine travelers, all under the Ministry of Communications and the Secretariat Military Department.

sentences.zh: 而站戶闕乏逃亡，則又以時簽補，且加賑恤焉。

translations.literal: When station households are deficient or flee, they are signed up and replenished in season, and relief is moreover added.
translations.idiomatic: Shortfalls and flight among station households were met with periodic conscription to fill gaps, together with relief measures.

sentences.zh: 於是四方往來之使，止則有館舍，頓則有供帳，饑渴則有飲食，而梯航畢達，海宇會同，元之天下，視前代所以為極盛也。

translations.literal: Thereupon envoys coming and going from the four quarters, when they halt have lodging houses, when they pause have supplies, when hungry or thirsty have food and drink; ladders and ships all reach their ends, sea and land are united, and the Yuan realm under Heaven was regarded as the utmost flourishing of former ages.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys from every direction could rest in hostels, draw provisions at halts, and find food and drink when needed; by land and sea routes alike the empire was knit together, and the Yuan domain was seen as surpassing all earlier dynasties in this respect.

sentences.zh: 今故著其驛政之大者，然後紀各省水陸凡若干站，而遼東狗站，亦因以附見云。

translations.literal: Now therefore the great matters of relay administration are set forth, and thereafter the land and water stations of each province, how many in all, are recorded; and the Liaodong dog-sled stations are also appended for reference.
translations.idiomatic: Here the principal features of relay policy are recorded, followed by the number of land and water stations in each province, with the Liaodong dog-sled relays noted as well.

sentences.zh: 太宗元年十一月，敕：「諸牛鋪馬站，每一百戶置漢車一十具。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the first year of Taizong, an edict: "At all ox- and horse-relay stations, for every hundred households ten Chinese carts shall be provided.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, year 1 of Taizong (Ögedei): "At every ox- and horse-relay station, each group of one hundred households shall maintain ten Chinese-style carts.

sentences.zh: 各站俱置米倉，站戶每年一牌內納米一石，令百戶一人掌之。

translations.literal: Every station shall alike set up a grain storehouse; station households each year within one household register plate pay in one shi of grain, ordering one person per hundred households to manage it.
translations.idiomatic: Each station was to maintain a grain depot; station households paid one shi of grain per year per register plate, managed by one man per hundred households.

sentences.zh: 北使臣每日支肉一斤、面一斤、米一升、酒一瓶。」

translations.literal: Northern envoys daily receive one jin of meat, one jin of flour, one sheng of grain, and one bottle of wine."
translations.idiomatic: Envoys from the north were allotted daily one jin of meat, one jin of flour, one sheng of grain, and one bottle of wine."

sentences.zh: 四年五月，諭隨路官員並站赤人等：「使臣無牌面文字，始給馬之驛官及元差官，皆罪之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of year 4, officials along the routes and jamči personnel were instructed: "If an envoy lacks a tablet with written authorization, the relay official who first gave horses and the original dispatching official are all punished.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, year 4: route officials and jamči staff were told: "If an envoy has no written credential on his tablet, both the relay officer who first issued horses and the original dispatching officer are liable.

sentences.zh: 有文字牌面，而不給驛馬者，亦論罪。

translations.literal: If there is a written tablet but relay horses are not given, punishment is also assessed.
translations.idiomatic: If a written tablet is presented but relay horses are refused, that too is punishable.

sentences.zh: 若系軍情急速，及送納顏色、絲線、酒食、米粟、段匹、鷹隼，但系御用諸物，雖無牌面文字，亦驗數應付車牛。」

translations.literal: If it concerns urgent military intelligence, or delivery of dyes, silk thread, food and drink, grain, silk bolts, or falcons—anything belonging to the imperial household—although there is no tablet with writing, the number is still verified and carts and oxen are supplied accordingly."
translations.idiomatic: For urgent military business or delivery of dyes, silk, provisions, grain, fabrics, falcons, or other imperial goods, horses and carts were to be furnished on count even without written tablets."

sentences.zh: 世祖中統四年三月，中書省定議乘坐驛馬，長行馬使臣、從人及下文字曳剌、解子人等分例。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year of Zhongtong of Shizu, the Secretariat fixed regulations on graded allowances for those riding relay horses: long-route horse envoys, attendants, and clerks bearing documents such as yela and messengers.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, Zhongtong 4 (1263): the Secretariat set graded allowances for relay travelers—long-route envoys, attendants, and document-bearing clerks and runners.

sentences.zh: 乘驛使臣換馬處，正使臣支粥食、解渴酒，從人支粥。

translations.literal: At relay horse-changing points for envoys riding the posts, the chief envoy receives congee and thirst-quenching wine; attendants receive congee.
translations.idiomatic: At horse-change stations the lead envoy received porridge and restorative wine; attendants received porridge.

sentences.zh: 宿頓處，正使臣白米一升，面一斤，酒一升，油鹽雜支鈔一十文，冬月一行日支炭五斤，十月一日為始，正月三十日終住支；

translations.literal: At overnight halts, the chief envoy receives one sheng of polished rice, one jin of flour, one sheng of wine, and ten cash in paper money for oil, salt, and miscellaneous expenses; in winter months, five jin of charcoal per day of travel, beginning the first day of the tenth month and ending provision on the thirtieth day of the first month;
translations.idiomatic: At overnight stops the lead envoy received one sheng of rice, one jin of flour, one sheng of wine, ten cash in paper notes for oil, salt, and incidentals, and five jin of charcoal per travel day in winter from the first of the tenth month through the thirtieth of the first month;

sentences.zh: 從人白米一升，面一斤。

translations.literal: Attendants receive one sheng of polished rice and one jin of flour.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants received one sheng of rice and one jin of flour.

sentences.zh: 長行馬使臣賫聖旨、令旨及省部文字，幹當官事者，其一二居長人員，支宿頓分例，次人與粥飯，仍支給馬一匹、草一十二斤、料五升，十月為始，至三月三十日終止，白米一升，面一斤，油鹽雜用鈔一十文。

translations.literal: Long-route horse envoys bearing imperial edicts, orders, and Secretariat or ministry documents on official business: for the one or two senior persons, overnight allowances are paid; subordinates receive congee and meals, and moreover one horse, twelve jin of fodder grass, and five sheng of grain feed are supplied from the tenth month through the thirtieth day of the third month, plus one sheng of polished rice, one jin of flour, and ten cash in paper money for oil, salt, and miscellaneous use.
translations.idiomatic: Long-route envoys carrying imperial edicts, orders, or central documents: the one or two senior members drew full overnight rations; juniors got porridge and meals plus one horse, twelve jin of hay, and five sheng of feed from the tenth month to the thirtieth of the third month, with one sheng of rice, one jin of flour, and ten cash for oil and salt.

sentences.zh: 投呈公文曳剌、解字，依部擬宿頓處批支。

translations.literal: Clerks presenting documents and copyists, according to ministry regulations, receive approval and payment at overnight halts.
translations.idiomatic: Clerks submitting papers and copyists were paid overnight allowances as approved by their ministry.

sentences.zh: 五月，雲州設站戶，取迤南州城站戶籍內，選堪中上戶應當。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Yunzhou established station households, selecting from among the station household registers of southern prefectures and cities those of upper-middle standing fit for service.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Yunzhou enrolled station households, choosing upper-middle households from southern prefectural registers.

sentences.zh: 馬站戶，馬一匹，牛站戶，牛二雙，於各戶選堪當站役之人，不問親軀，每戶取二丁，及家屬於立站去處安置。

translations.literal: Horse-station households, one horse; ox-station households, two pairs of oxen—from each household select persons fit for station labor, regardless of kinship body, take two males per household together with dependents, and settle them at the place where the station is established.
translations.idiomatic: Horse stations required one horse per household; ox stations two pairs of oxen; two able men per household, with families, were relocated to the new station site regardless of kin ties.

sentences.zh: 五年八月，詔：「站戶貧富不等，每戶限四頃，除免稅石，以供鋪馬祗應；

translations.literal: In the eighth month of year 5, an edict: "Station households are unequal in wealth; each household is limited to four qing, with tax grain exempted to supply relay-horse service;
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, year 5: "Because station households varied in wealth, each was limited to four qing of land with tax grain remitted for relay service;

sentences.zh: 已上地畝，全納地稅。」

translations.literal: Land above that amount pays land tax in full."
translations.idiomatic: any acreage above that limit paid the full land tax."

sentences.zh: 至元六年二月，詔：「各道憲司，如總管府例，每道給鋪馬劄子三道。」

translations.literal: In the second month of the sixth year of Zhiyuan, an edict: "Each circuit surveillance commission, following the precedent of the route chief's office, is given three relay-horse warrants per circuit."
translations.idiomatic: Second month, Zhiyuan 6 (1269): "Each circuit surveillance commission, like a route chief's office, receives three relay-horse warrants."

sentences.zh: 七年正月，省部官定議：「各路總管府在城驛，設官二員，於見役人員內選用；

translations.literal: In the first month of year 7, Secretariat and ministry officials fixed regulations: "Relay stations in cities under route chief's offices shall have two officials, chosen from among persons currently on service;
translations.idiomatic: First month, year 7: "Urban relays under route governments shall have two officers selected from active personnel;

sentences.zh: 州縣驛，設頭目二名，如見役人即是相應站戶，就令依上任事，不系站戶，則就本站馬戶內別行選用；

translations.literal: Prefectural and county relays shall have two headmen; if the person currently on service is the appropriate station household, he is ordered to continue in office; if not tied to a station household, then separately chosen from among this station's horse households;
translations.idiomatic: prefectural and county relays two headmen—if the incumbent is a qualified station household he remains; otherwise a horse household at that station is chosen;

sentences.zh: 除脫脫禾孫依舊存設，隨路見設總站官罷之。」

translations.literal: except that todoqsons remain as before, the route-level chief station offices now established are abolished."
translations.idiomatic: except that todoqsons remain as before, the route-level chief station offices now established are abolished."

sentences.zh: 十一月，立諸站都統領使司，往來使臣，令脫脫禾孫盤問。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, the Office of the Chief Superintendent of All Stations was established; envoys coming and going are ordered to be examined by todoqsons.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: the Office of the Chief Superintendent of All Stations was created, with todoqsons to examine traveling envoys.

sentences.zh: 八年正月，中書省議：「鋪馬劄子，初用蒙古字，各處站赤未能盡識，宜繪畫馬匹數目，復以省印覆之，庶無疑惑。」

translations.literal: In the first month of year 8, the Secretariat deliberated: "Relay-horse warrants, at first using Mongol script, could not be fully recognized at jamči everywhere; it is fitting to depict the number of horses and moreover overlay the provincial seal, so that there will be no doubt."
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 8, the Secretariat deliberated: "Relay-horse warrants, at first using Mongol script, could not be fully recognized at jamči everywhere; it is fitting to depict the number of horses and moreover overlay the provincial seal, so that there will be no doubt."

sentences.zh: 因命今後各處取給鋪馬標附文籍，其馬匹數付譯史房書寫畢，就左右司用墨印，印給馬數目，省印印訖，別行附籍發行墨印，左右司封掌。

translations.literal: Thereupon it was ordered that hereafter at each place the relay-horse warrant with attached register be taken; when the number of horses is written out by the translation office, the Left and Right Offices use ink seals to stamp the horse count; after the provincial seal is applied, a separate attached register is issued with ink seal; the Left and Right Offices keep custody.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth warrants were to list horse numbers in the translation office, stamped with ink seals by the Left and Right Offices, then the provincial seal, with a duplicate register held by those offices.

sentences.zh: 九年八月，諸站都統領使司言：「朝省諸司局院，及外路諸官府應差馳驛使臣所賫劄子，從脫脫禾孫辨詰，無脫脫禾孫之處，令總管府驗之。」

translations.literal: In the eighth month of year 9, the Office of the Chief Superintendent of All Stations reported: "Bureaus and offices of the court and provincial governments dispatching relay envoys with warrants—examination by todoqsons; where there are no todoqsons, the route chief's office verifies them."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year 9, the Office of the Chief Superintendent of All Stations reported: "Bureaus and offices of the court and provincial governments dispatching relay envoys with warrants—examination by todoqsons; where there are no todoqsons, the route chief's office verifies them."

sentences.zh: 十一年十月，命隨處站赤，直隸各路總管府，其站戶家屬，令元籍州縣管領。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of year 11, it was ordered that jamči everywhere be placed directly under each route chief's office, while station household dependents remain under administration of their original prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, year 11: all jamči were placed under route governments; station families stayed registered in their home counties.

sentences.zh: 十三年正月，改諸站都統領使司為通政院，命降鑄印信。

translations.literal: In the first month of year 13, the Office of the Chief Superintendent of All Stations was changed to the Ministry of Communications, and orders were given to cast and lower its seal.
translations.idiomatic: First month, year 13: the chief superintendent's office became the Ministry of Communications and received a new seal.

sentences.zh: 十七年二月，詔：「江淮諸路增置水站。

translations.literal: In the second month of year 17, an edict: "The Jiang-Huai routes shall add water stations.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, year 17: "Water stations are to be added on the Jiang-Huai routes.

sentences.zh: 除海青使臣，及事幹軍務者，方許馳驛。

translations.literal: Except for sea-eagle envoys and matters touching military affairs, only then is riding the relay permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Only sea-eagle envoys and military business may use the horse relays.

sentences.zh: 余者自濟州水站為始，並令乘船往來。」

translations.literal: The rest, beginning from Jizhou water station, are all ordered to travel by boat."
translations.idiomatic: All others, from Jizhou water station onward, must travel by boat."

sentences.zh: 十八年閏八月，詔：「除上都、榆林迤北站赤外，隨路官錢，不須支給，驗其閑劇，量增站戶，協力自備首思當站。」

translations.literal: In the intercalary eighth month of year 18, an edict: "Except for jamči from Shangdu and Yulin northward, official money along the routes need not be disbursed; verifying busy and slack traffic, station households are increased in number to cooperate in providing shusi for station service themselves."
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary eighth month of year 18, an edict: "Except for jamči from Shangdu and Yulin northward, official money along the routes need not be disbursed; verifying busy and slack traffic, station households are increased in number to cooperate in providing shusi for station service themselves."

sentences.zh: 十九年四月，詔給各處行省鋪馬聖旨，揚州行省、鄂州行省、泉州行省、隆興行省、占城行省、安西行省、四川行省、西夏行省、甘州行省，每省五道。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of year 19, an edict gave each provincial branch relay-horse imperial edicts: Yangzhou, Ezhou, Quanzhou, Longxing, Zhancheng, Anxi, Sichuan, Xixia, and Ganzhou branches, five each.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, year 19: relay-horse imperial edicts were issued to the Yangzhou, Ezhou, Quanzhou, Longxing, Zhancheng, Anxi, Sichuan, Xixia, and Ganzhou branch secretariats, five for each province.

sentences.zh: 南方驗田糧及七十石者，準當站馬一匹。

translations.literal: In the south, those with field tax grain of seventy shi qualify to supply one relay horse.
translations.idiomatic: In the south, seventy shi of field-tax grain qualified a household to furnish one relay horse.

sentences.zh: 九月，通政院臣言：「隨路站赤三五戶，共當正馬一匹，十三戶供車一輛，自備一切什物公用。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Ministry of Communications officials reported: "Along the routes, three to five jamči households jointly supply one main horse; thirteen households supply one cart, themselves providing all utensils in common use.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Ministry of Communications officials reported: "Along the routes, three to five jamči households jointly supply one main horse; thirteen households supply one cart, themselves providing all utensils in common use.

sentences.zh: 近年以來，多為諸王公主及正宮太子位下頭目識認招收，或冒入投下戶計者，遂致站赤損弊，乞換補站戶。」

translations.literal: In recent years many have been recognized and recruited by princes, princesses, and chief consorts of the heir apparent, or falsely entered into appanage household registers, so that jamči have been damaged; we beg to replace and replenish station households."
translations.idiomatic: In recent years many have been recognized and recruited by princes, princesses, and chief consorts of the heir apparent, or falsely entered into appanage household registers, so that jamči have been damaged; we beg to replace and replenish station households."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 十月，增給各省鋪馬聖旨，西川、京兆、泉州十道，甘州、中興各五道。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, relay-horse imperial edicts were increased for the provinces: Xichuan and Jingzhao ten each, Quanzhou ten, Ganzhou and Zhongxing five each.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month: additional relay-horse edicts—ten each for Xichuan and Jingzhao, ten for Quanzhou, five each for Ganzhou and Zhongxing.

sentences.zh: 二十年二月，和林宣慰司給鋪馬聖旨二道。

translations.literal: In the second month of year 20, the Helin Pacification Commission was given two relay-horse imperial edicts.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, year 20: the Helin Pacification Commission received two relay-horse imperial edicts.

sentences.zh: 五月，江淮行省增給十道，都省遣使繁多，亦增二十道給之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the Jiang-Huai Branch Secretariat was given ten more; because the central government sent many envoys, twenty more were also added.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: the Jiang-Huai branch received ten more, and twenty more for frequent central envoys.

sentences.zh: 七月，免站戶和顧和買、一切雜泛差役，仍令自備首思。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, station households were exempted from corvée purchases and all miscellaneous levies, and were still ordered to provide shusi themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: station households were freed from corvée purchases and miscellaneous levies but still had to furnish shusi.

sentences.zh: 十一月，增給甘州行省鋪馬聖旨十道，總之為二十道。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, the Ganzhou Branch Secretariat was given ten more relay-horse imperial edicts, totaling twenty.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: Ganzhou branch received ten more relay-horse edicts, twenty in all.

sentences.zh: 十二月，增各省及轉運司、宣慰司鋪馬聖旨三十五道：江淮行省十道，四川行省十道，安西轉運司分司二道，荊湖行省所轄湖南宣慰司三道，福建行省十道。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, relay-horse imperial edicts for the provinces and transport and pacification commissions were increased by thirty-five: Jiang-Huai Branch ten, Sichuan Branch ten, Anxi Transport Sub-commission two, Huguang Branch's Hunan Pacification Commission three, Fujian Branch ten.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month: thirty-five more edicts—to Jiang-Huai and Sichuan branches ten each, Anxi transport sub-commission two, Hunan under Huguang three, Fujian ten.

sentences.zh: 二十一年二月，增給各處鋪馬劄子：荊湖、占城等處本省一十道，荊湖北道宣慰司二道，所轄路分一十六處，每處二道；

translations.literal: In the second month of year 21, relay-horse warrants were increased for each place: the Huguang and Zhancheng branch secretariats ten each, the Huguang North Circuit Pacification Commission two, and the sixteen circuits under its jurisdiction two each;
translations.idiomatic: Second month, year 21: more warrants—to Huguang and Zhancheng branches ten each, Huguang North Circuit two, and two per each of sixteen subordinate circuits;

sentences.zh: 山東運司二道；

translations.literal: Shandong Transport Commission two;
translations.idiomatic: Shandong Transport Commission, two;

sentences.zh: 河間運司七道；

translations.literal: Hejian Transport Commission seven;
translations.idiomatic: Hejian Transport Commission, seven;

sentences.zh: 宣德府三道；

translations.literal: Xuande Prefecture three;
translations.idiomatic: Xuande Prefecture, three;

sentences.zh: 江西行省五道；

translations.literal: Jiangxi Branch Secretariat five;
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi Branch Secretariat, five;

sentences.zh: 福建行省所轄路分七處，每處二道；

translations.literal: Seven circuits under the Fujian Branch Secretariat, two each;
translations.idiomatic: seven Fujian branch circuits, two each;

sentences.zh: 司農司五道；

translations.literal: Ministry of Agriculture five;
translations.idiomatic: Ministry of Agriculture, five;

sentences.zh: 四川行省所轄順元路宣慰司三道，思州、播州兩處宣撫司各三道；

translations.literal: Shunyuan Circuit Pacification Commission under the Sichuan Branch Secretariat three, and the Xun and Bo Pacification Commissions three each;
translations.idiomatic: Shunyuan under Sichuan three, Xun and Bo pacification commissions three each;

sentences.zh: 都省二十道。

translations.literal: the central government twenty.
translations.idiomatic: the central government, twenty.

sentences.zh: 四月，定增使臣分例：正使宿頓支米一升、面一斤、羊肉一斤、酒一升、柴一束、油鹽雜支增鈔二分，通作三分，經過減半。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, envoy allowances were further fixed: at overnight halts the chief envoy receives one sheng of grain, one jin of flour, one jin of mutton, one sheng of wine, one bundle of firewood, and miscellaneous expenses increased by two cash in paper money to three cash in all, halved when merely passing through.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month: overnight rations for the lead envoy were set at one sheng of grain, one jin each of flour and mutton, one sheng of wine, one bundle of fuel, and three cash total for incidentals, halved en route.

sentences.zh: 從者每名支米一升，經過減半。

translations.literal: Each attendant receives one sheng of grain, halved when passing through.
translations.idiomatic: Each attendant received one sheng of grain, halved when passing through.

sentences.zh: 九月，給阿裏海牙所治之省鋪馬聖旨十道，所轄宣慰司二處，各三道。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the province governed by Alihaiya was given ten relay-horse imperial edicts, and the two pacification commissions under it three each.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Alihaiya's province received ten relay-horse edicts and its two pacification commissions three each.

sentences.zh: 二十二年四月，給陜西行省並各處宣慰司、行工部等處鋪馬劄子一百二十六道。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of year 22, the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat and each pacification commission and the Works Department and other offices were given one hundred twenty-six relay-horse warrants.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, year 22: Shaanxi branch, pacification commissions, Works Department, and others received 126 relay-horse warrants.

sentences.zh: 二十三年四月，福建、東京兩行省各給圓牌二面。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of year 23, the Fujian and Dongjing branch secretariats were each given two round tokens.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, year 23: Fujian and Dongjing branches each received two round tokens.

sentences.zh: 奧魯赤出使交趾，先給圓牌二面，今再增二面，於脫歡太子位下給發。

translations.literal: Aoluchi on mission to Jiaozhi was first given two round tokens; now two more are added, to be issued under the household of Prince Togon.
translations.idiomatic: Aoluchi's mission to Jiaozhi had two round tokens; two more were added, issued from Prince Togon's establishment.

sentences.zh: 南京行省起馬三十匹，給圓牌二面。

translations.literal: The Nanjing Branch Secretariat raises thirty horses and is given two round tokens.
translations.idiomatic: The Nanjing branch, raising thirty horses, received two round tokens.

sentences.zh: 創立三處宣慰司，給劄子起馬三十匹。

translations.literal: Three newly established pacification commissions are each given warrants raising thirty horses.
translations.idiomatic: Three new pacification commissions each received warrants for thirty horses.

sentences.zh: 二十四年四月，增給尚書省鋪馬聖旨一百五十道，並先給降一百五十道，共三百道。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of year 24, the Secretariat was given one hundred fifty more relay-horse imperial edicts, together with the one hundred fifty previously issued, three hundred in all.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, year 24: the Secretariat received 150 more relay-horse edicts, 300 with those already issued.

sentences.zh: 五月，揚州省言：「徐州至揚州水馬站，兩各分置，夏月水潦，使臣勞苦。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the Yangzhou branch reported: "From Xuzhou to Yangzhou, water and horse stations are set apart in two places; in summer floods, envoys suffer hardship.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the Yangzhou branch reported: "From Xuzhou to Yangzhou, water and horse stations are set apart in two places; in summer floods, envoys suffer hardship.

sentences.zh: 請徙馬站附並水站一處安置，馳驛者白日馬行，夜則經由水路，況站戶皆是水濱居止者，庶幾官民兩便。」

translations.literal: We request moving the horse station to be attached and settled together with the water station in one place; those riding the relay travel by horse in daytime and at night go by water route; moreover station households all dwell on the water's edge, so that perhaps official and people alike are convenient."
translations.idiomatic: We request moving the horse station to be attached and settled together with the water station in one place; those riding the relay travel by horse in daytime and at night go by water route; moreover station households all dwell on the water's edge, so that perhaps official and people alike are convenient."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 七月，給中興路、陜西行省、廣東宣慰司、沙不丁等官鋪馬聖旨一十三道。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Zhongxing Circuit, Shaanxi Branch Secretariat, Guangdong Pacification Commission, and the officials Shabuding and others were given thirteen relay-horse imperial edicts.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Zhongxing circuit, Shaanxi branch, Guangdong pacification commission, and Shabuding's office received thirteen relay-horse edicts.

sentences.zh: 二十五年正月，腹裏路分三十八處，年銷祗應錢不敷，增給鈔三千九百八十一錠，並元額七千一百六十九錠，總中統鈔一萬一千一百五十錠，分上下半年給降。

translations.literal: In the first month of year 25, thirty-eight circuits in the metropolitan region had insufficient annual service funds; an additional three thousand nine hundred eighty-one ingots of paper money were granted, together with the original seven thousand one hundred sixty-nine ingots, totaling eleven thousand one hundred fifty ingots of Zhongtong paper money, issued in two halves-year distributions.
translations.idiomatic: First month, year 25: thirty-eight metropolitan circuits needed more service money—3,981 ingots added to 7,169, totaling 11,150 Zhongtong notes in semiannual issues.

sentences.zh: 二月，命南方站戶，以糧七十石出馬一匹為則，或十石之下八九戶共之，或二三十石之上兩三戶共之，惟求稅糧僅足當站之數，不至多余，卻免其一切雜泛差役。

translations.literal: In the second month, it was ordered that southern station households take seventy shi of grain supplying one horse as the rule, or eight or nine households jointly below ten shi, or two or three households jointly above twenty or thirty shi—only seeking that tax grain barely suffices for the station quota and does not exceed, yet exempting all miscellaneous levies.
translations.idiomatic: Second month: southern station households were to supply one horse per seventy shi of grain, with smaller groups pooling below ten shi and larger households sharing above twenty or thirty shi, exempt from miscellaneous levies if quotas were met.

sentences.zh: 若有納糧百石之下、七十石之上，自請獨當站馬一匹者聽之。

translations.literal: If there are those below one hundred shi of paid grain and above seventy shi who request to undertake one relay horse alone, they are permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Households paying between seventy and one hundred shi could volunteer to supply a horse alone.

sentences.zh: 五月，增給遼陽行省鋪馬劄子五道。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the Liaoyang Branch Secretariat was given five more relay-horse warrants.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: Liaoyang branch received five more relay-horse warrants.

sentences.zh: 十一月，福建行省元給鋪馬聖旨二十四道，增給劄子六道。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, the Fujian Branch Secretariat originally had twenty-four relay-horse imperial edicts; six more warrants were added.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: Fujian branch, which had twenty-four relay-horse edicts, received six more warrants.

sentences.zh: 二十六年正月，給光祿寺鋪馬劄子四道。

translations.literal: In the first month of year 26, the Imperial Household Directorate was given four relay-horse warrants.
translations.idiomatic: First month, year 26: the Imperial Household Directorate received four relay-horse warrants.

sentences.zh: 二月，從沿海鎮守官蔡澤言，以舊有水軍二千人，於海道置立水站。

translations.literal: In the second month, following Coastal Defense Commander Cai Ze's proposal, the former two-thousand-man naval force was used to establish water stations along the sea route.
translations.idiomatic: Second month: on Cai Ze's advice, two thousand former naval troops were assigned to sea-route water stations.

sentences.zh: 三月，給海道運糧萬戶府鋪馬聖旨五道。

translations.literal: In the third month, the Sea-Route Grain Transport Ten-thousand Households Office was given five relay-horse imperial edicts.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: the sea-route grain transport office received five relay-horse edicts.

sentences.zh: 四月，四川紹慶路給鋪馬劄子二道，成都府六道。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Shaojiang Circuit in Sichuan was given two relay-horse warrants and Chengdu Prefecture six.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month: Shaojiang circuit in Sichuan two warrants, Chengdu prefecture six.

sentences.zh: 龍興行省增給鋪馬聖旨五道，太原府宣慰司及儲峙提舉司給降二道。

translations.literal: The Longxing Branch Secretariat was given five more relay-horse imperial edicts; the Taiyuan Pacification Commission and the Storage and Provision Office were each given two.
translations.idiomatic: Longxing branch five more relay-horse edicts; Taiyuan pacification commission and storage office two each.

sentences.zh: 八月，給遼東宣慰司鋪馬聖旨五道，大理、金齒宣慰司四道。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, the Liaodong Pacification Commission was given five relay-horse imperial edicts, and Dali and Jinchi Pacification Commission four.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: Liaodong pacification commission five relay-horse edicts; Dali and Jinchi four.

sentences.zh: 九月，增給西京宣慰司鋪馬劄子五道，江淮行省所轄浙東道宣慰司三道，紹興路總管府給降二道，甘肅行省所轄亦集乃總管府、沙州、肅州三路給六道。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the Xijing Pacification Commission was given five more relay-horse warrants; the Zhedong Circuit Pacification Commission under the Jiang-Huai Branch Secretariat three; Shaoxing Route Chief's Office two; and under the Gansu Branch Secretariat the Yijinai Chief's Office and Shazhou and Suzhou circuits six.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Xijing pacification five warrants; Zhedong under Jiang-Huai three; Shaoxing two; under Gansu branch Yijinai, Shazhou, and Suzhou six.

sentences.zh: 十一月，增給甘肅行省鋪馬聖旨七道。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, the Gansu Branch Secretariat was given seven more relay-horse imperial edicts.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: Gansu branch seven more relay-horse edicts.

sentences.zh: 二十七年正月，增給陜西行省鋪馬聖旨五道。

translations.literal: In the first month of year 27, the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat was given five more relay-horse imperial edicts.
translations.idiomatic: First month, year 27: Shaanxi branch five more relay-horse edicts.

sentences.zh: 二月，都省增給鋪馬聖旨一百五十道，江淮行省一十五道。

translations.literal: In the second month, the central government was given one hundred fifty more relay-horse imperial edicts, and the Jiang-Huai Branch Secretariat fifteen.
translations.idiomatic: Second month: the central government 150 more relay-horse edicts; Jiang-Huai branch fifteen.

sentences.zh: 六月，給營田提舉司鋪馬聖旨二道。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the Military Farms Office was given two relay-horse imperial edicts.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: Military Farms Office two relay-horse edicts.

sentences.zh: 九月，江淮行省所轄徽州路水道不通，給鋪馬聖旨二道。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Huizhou Circuit under the Jiang-Huai Branch Secretariat had impassable waterways and was given two relay-horse imperial edicts.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Huizhou under Jiang-Huai, where waterways were blocked, received two relay-horse edicts.

sentences.zh: 二十八年六月，隨處設站官二員，大都至上都置司吏三名，余設二名，祗應頭目、攢典各一名。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of year 28, two station officials were established everywhere; from Dadu to Shangdu three clerks were posted, elsewhere two; one supply headman and one registry clerk each.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, year 28: two station officers were appointed everywhere—three clerks on the Dadu–Shangdu route, two elsewhere—plus one supply headman and one registry clerk.

sentences.zh: 站戶及百者，設百戶一名。

translations.literal: Where station households reach one hundred, one centurion headman is established.
translations.idiomatic: Where households reached one hundred, a centurion headman was appointed.

sentences.zh: 七月，詔各路府州縣達魯花赤長官，依軍戶例，兼管站赤奧魯，非奉通政院明文，不得擅科差役。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, an edict ordered route, prefecture, and county darughachi chiefs, following the military-household precedent, jointly to administer jamči ulus households; without written authorization from the Ministry of Communications they may not impose levies on their own.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: local darughachi chiefs were to oversee jamči households as with military households and could not levy duties without ministry authorization.

sentences.zh: 十二月，增給省除之任官鋪馬聖旨三百五十道。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, three hundred fifty relay-horse imperial edicts were added for officials appointed by central order.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month: 350 relay-horse edicts for centrally appointed officials.

sentences.zh: 二十九年三月，命通政院分官四員，於江南四省整理站赤，給印與之。

translations.literal: In the third month of year 29, it was ordered that the Ministry of Communications divide four officials, in the four southern provinces, to put jamči in order, and seals were given them.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, year 29: four ministry officials with seals were sent to reorganize jamči in the four southern provinces.

sentences.zh: 三十年正月，南丹州洞蠻來朝，立安撫司於其地，給鋪馬聖旨二道。

translations.literal: In the first month of year 30, cave barbarians of Nandanzhou came to court; a pacification commission was established in their territory and two relay-horse imperial edicts were given.
translations.idiomatic: First month, year 30: Nandan cave tribes presented tribute; a pacification commission was set up there with two relay-horse edicts.

sentences.zh: 三月，兩淮都轉運鹽使司增給鋪馬聖旨起馬五匹。

translations.literal: In the third month, the Huai-Yang Salt Transport Commission was given relay-horse imperial edicts raising five horses.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: Huai-Yang Salt Transport Commission received relay-horse edicts for five horses.

sentences.zh: 五月，給淘金運司鋪馬聖旨起馬五匹，大司農司起馬二十匹。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the Gold-washing Transport Office was given relay-horse imperial edicts raising five horses, and the Grand Secretariat twenty horses.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: Gold-washing Transport Office five horses; Grand Secretariat twenty.

sentences.zh: 六月，江浙行省言：「各路遞運站船，若止以六戶供船一艘，除苗不過十四五石，力寡不能當役。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat reported: "Relay transport boats on the routes, if only six households supply one boat, besides seed grain not exceeding fourteen or fifteen shi, strength is scant and cannot bear the service.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat reported: "Relay transport boats on the routes, if only six households supply one boat, besides seed grain not exceeding fourteen or fifteen shi, strength is scant and cannot bear the service.

sentences.zh: 請令各路除苗不過元額二十四石，自六戶之上，或至十戶，通融簽撥。」

translations.literal: We request ordering each route to deduct seed grain not exceeding the original quota of twenty-four shi, and from six households upward, or up to ten households, flexibly sign and allocate."
translations.idiomatic: We request ordering each route to deduct seed grain not exceeding the original quota of twenty-four shi, and from six households upward, or up to ten households, flexibly sign and allocate."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 八月，給劉二拔都兒圓牌三面，鋪馬聖旨一十五道。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Liu Erbaduer was given three round tokens and fifteen relay-horse imperial edicts.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: Liu Erbaduer received three round tokens and fifteen relay-horse edicts.

sentences.zh: 十月，增給濟南府鹽運司鋪馬聖旨一道。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, the Jinan Prefecture Salt Transport Commission was given one more relay-horse imperial edict.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month: Jinan Salt Transport Commission received one additional relay-horse edict.

sentences.zh: 三十一年六月，給福建運司鋪馬聖旨起馬五匹。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of year 31, the Fujian Transport Commission was given relay-horse imperial edicts raising five horses.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, year 31: Fujian Transport Commission received relay-horse edicts for five horses.

sentences.zh: 成宗大德八年正月，御史臺臣言：「各處站赤合用祗應官錢，多不依時撥降，又或數少不給，遂令站戶輪當庫子，陪備應辦。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighth year of Dade of Chengzong, censorate officials reported: "Official money required for jamči service at each place is mostly not disbursed on schedule, or the amount given is insufficient, so station households take turns serving as depot clerks and supply provisions at their own expense.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eighth year of Dade of Chengzong, censorate officials reported: "Official money required for jamči service at each place is mostly not disbursed on schedule, or the amount given is insufficient, so station households take turns serving as depot clerks and supply provisions at their own expense.

sentences.zh: 莫若驗使臣起數，實支官錢，所在官司，依時撥降，令各站提領收掌祗待，毋得科配小民，似為便益。」

translations.literal: It would be better to verify the number of envoys raised and actually disburse official money; local offices should disburse on schedule, ordering each station superintendent to receive and manage hospitality, and not impose exactions on common people—this seems beneficial."
translations.idiomatic: It would be better to verify the number of envoys raised and actually disburse official money; local offices should disburse on schedule, ordering each station superintendent to receive and manage hospitality, and not impose exactions on common people—this seems beneficial."

sentences.zh: 詔都省定議行之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the central government to fix regulations and implement them.
translations.idiomatic: The central government was ordered to set rules and carry them out.

sentences.zh: 十年，從江浙省言，命站官仍領祗待，選站戶之有餘糧者，以充庫子，止設一名，上下半年更代，就準本戶里正、主首身役。

translations.literal: In year 10, following the Jiang-Zhe branch's proposal, station officers were again put in charge of hospitality; station households with surplus grain were chosen as depot clerks, only one post established, replaced every half year, counted as the village head and neighborhood chief service of that household.
translations.idiomatic: Year 10: on Jiang-Zhe's advice, station officers again managed hospitality; one surplus-grain household per station served as depot clerk on six-month rotation, counting as its headman duties.

sentences.zh: 武宗至大三年五月，給嘉興、松江、瑞州三路及汴梁等處管民總管府鋪馬聖旨各三道。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the third year of Zhidu of Wuzong, Jiaxing, Songjiang, and Ruizhou circuits and the Bianliang and other Civilian Chief Commissions were each given three relay-horse imperial edicts.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, Zhidu 3 (1310): Jiaxing, Songjiang, Ruizhou, and Bianliang civilian chief commissions each received three relay-horse edicts.

sentences.zh: 四年三月，詔拘收各衙門鋪馬聖旨，命中書省定議以聞。

translations.literal: In the third month of year 4, an edict ordered confiscation of relay-horse imperial edicts held by each yamen and commanded the Secretariat to deliberate and report.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, year 4: relay-horse edicts in every office were to be confiscated pending Secretariat review.

sentences.zh: 省臣言：「始者站赤隸兵站，後屬通政院，今通政院怠於整治，站赤消乏，合依舊命兵部領之。」

translations.literal: Secretariat officials reported: "At first jamči belonged to the military stations, later to the Ministry of Communications; now the ministry is slack in regulation and jamči are depleted—it is fitting to restore them to the Military Department as before."
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat officials reported: "At first jamči belonged to the military stations, later to the Ministry of Communications; now the ministry is slack in regulation and jamči are depleted—it is fitting to restore them to the Military Department as before."

sentences.zh: 制可。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 四月，中書省臣又言：「昨奉旨以站赤屬兵部，今右丞相鐵木叠兒等議，漢地之驛，命兵部領之，其鐵烈幹、納鄰、末鄰等處蒙古站赤，仍付通政院。」

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Secretariat officials again reported: "Yesterday we received the edict placing jamči under the Military Department; now Right Chancellor Temür Ochir and others deliberate: Han land relays should be led by the Military Department; Mongol jamči at Tieleghan, Nalin, Molin, and other places should still be handed to the Ministry of Communications."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Secretariat officials again reported: "Yesterday we received the edict placing jamči under the Military Department; now Right Chancellor Temür Ochir and others deliberate: Han land relays should be led by the Military Department; Mongol jamči at Tieleghan, Nalin, Molin, and other places should still be handed to the Ministry of Communications."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「何必如此，但令罷通政院，悉隸兵部可也。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Why need it be thus? Simply abolish the Ministry of Communications and place all under the Military Department."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied: "Why split them? Abolish the ministry and put everything under the Military Department."

sentences.zh: 閏七月，復立通政院，領蒙古站赤。

translations.literal: In the intercalary seventh month, the Ministry of Communications was re-established to lead Mongol jamči.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary seventh month: the Ministry of Communications was restored for Mongol jamči.

sentences.zh: 八月，詔：「大都至上都，每站除設驛令、丞外，設提領三員、司吏三名。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, an edict: "From Dadu to Shangdu, at each station besides relay commissioners and assistants, three superintendents and three clerks shall be established.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, an edict: "From Dadu to Shangdu, at each station besides relay commissioners and assistants, three superintendents and three clerks shall be established.

sentences.zh: 腹裏路分，沖要水陸站赤，設提領二員、司吏二名。

translations.literal: In metropolitan circuits, at busy land and water jamči, two superintendents and two clerks shall be established.
translations.idiomatic: Busy metropolitan land and water stations received two superintendents and two clerks.

sentences.zh: 其餘閑慢驛分，止設提領一員、司吏一名。

translations.literal: The remaining slack relay divisions shall have only one superintendent and one clerk.
translations.idiomatic: Quieter stations had only one superintendent and one clerk.

sentences.zh: 如無驛令，量擬提領二員。

translations.literal: If there is no relay commissioner, provisionally two superintendents are to be appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Stations without commissioners were to have two superintendents pro tempore.

sentences.zh: 每一百戶，設百戶一名，從拘該路府州縣提調正官，於站戶內選用，三歲為滿。

translations.literal: For every hundred households, one centurion headman is established, following the supervising chief official of the route, prefecture, and county concerned, chosen from among station households, with a three-year term.

sentences.zh: ○弓手

translations.literal: ○ Archers
translations.idiomatic: ○ Archers

sentences.zh: 元制，郡邑設弓手，以防盜也。

translations.literal: Yuan institutions: prefectures and districts establish archers to guard against bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yuan law, counties and districts maintained archers against banditry.

sentences.zh: 內而京師，有南北兩城兵馬司，外而諸路府所轄州縣，設縣尉司、巡檢司、捕盜所，置巡軍弓手，而其數則有多寡之不同。

translations.literal: Within, in the capital, there are North and South City Horse and Infantry Commissions; without, in prefectures and districts under route governments, county commandant offices, inspection offices, and bandit-catching offices are established, posting patrol soldiers and archers, while their numbers differ in more or less.
translations.idiomatic: In the capital the North and South City Horse and Infantry Commissions stood guard; in the provinces county commandants, inspectors, and bandit offices deployed patrol troops and archers in varying numbers.

sentences.zh: 職巡邏，專捕獲。

translations.literal: Their duty is patrol, specializing in capture.
translations.idiomatic: Their duty was patrol and arrest.

sentences.zh: 官有綱運及流徙者至，則執兵仗導道，以轉相授受。

translations.literal: When officials with transported convicts or exiles arrive, they take up arms to escort and hand over in relay.
translations.idiomatic: When convicts or exiles in official transport arrived, they escorted with weapons and relayed custody.

sentences.zh: 外此則不敢役，示專其職焉。

translations.literal: Beyond this they dare not be impressed for service, showing dedication to their specialty.
translations.idiomatic: They were not used for other tasks, to keep their role distinct.

sentences.zh: 世祖中統五年，隨州府驛路設置巡馬及馬步弓手，驗民戶多寡，定立額數。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Zhongtong of Shizu, along the Suizhou Prefecture relay route patrol horses and mounted and foot archers were established, verifying household numbers more or less to fix quotas.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongtong 5 (1264): Suizhou relay route gained patrol horses and mounted and foot archers sized to local household counts.

sentences.zh: 除本管頭目外，本處長官兼充提控官。

translations.literal: Besides their own supervising headmen, the local chief official concurrently serves as control officer.
translations.idiomatic: Local chiefs doubled as control officers besides regular headmen.

sentences.zh: 其夜禁之法，一更三點，鐘聲絕，禁人行；

translations.literal: The night-curfew law: at the third stroke of the first watch, when the bell sound ends, travel by persons is forbidden;
translations.idiomatic: Night curfew: after the third stroke of the first watch bell, travel was forbidden;

sentences.zh: 五更三點，鐘聲動，聽人行。

translations.literal: at the third stroke of the fifth watch, when the bell sound moves, persons are permitted to travel.
translations.idiomatic: after the third stroke of the fifth watch bell, travel was allowed.

sentences.zh: 有公事急速及喪病產育之類，則不在此限。

translations.literal: When there is urgent official business and matters such as mourning, illness, or childbirth, then they are not within this limit.
translations.idiomatic: Urgent official business and funerals, illness, or childbirth were exempt.

sentences.zh: 違者笞二十七下，有官者笞七下，準贖元寶鈔一貫。

translations.literal: Violators receive twenty-seven strokes of the cane; those with office receive seven strokes, commutable by one ingot of Yuanbao paper money.
translations.idiomatic: Violators were caned twenty-seven times; officials seven, redeemable for one ingot of Yuanbao notes.

sentences.zh: 州縣城池相離遠處，其間五七十里，所有村店及二十戶以上者，設立巡防弓手，合用器仗，必須完備，令本縣長官提調。

translations.literal: Where prefectural and county walled cities are far apart, in the intervals of fifty or seventy li, at every village inn and place of twenty households or more, patrol archers are established; required weapons must be complete, ordered to be supervised by the county chief of that county.
translations.idiomatic: Between distant county seats, villages of twenty households or more along fifty–seventy li stretches had patrol archers with full arms under county chiefs.

sentences.zh: 不及二十戶者，依數差補。

translations.literal: Those not reaching twenty households are supplemented according to number.
translations.idiomatic: Smaller settlements were filled to quota.

sentences.zh: 若無村店去處，或五七十里，創立聚落店舍，亦須及二十戶數。

translations.literal: If there is no village inn, or at fifty or seventy li a new clustered settlement inn is created, it must also reach twenty households.
translations.idiomatic: New settlements without inns still needed twenty households before archers were posted.

sentences.zh: 其巡軍別設，不在戶數之內。

translations.literal: Patrol soldiers are separately established, not within the household count.
translations.idiomatic: Separate patrol troops did not count toward household quotas.

sentences.zh: 關津渡口，必當設立店舍弓手去處，不在五七十里之限。

translations.literal: At passes, fords, and ferry crossings, where inn archers must be established, the fifty- or seventy-li limit does not apply.
translations.idiomatic: Passes and ferries required inn archers regardless of distance limits.

sentences.zh: 於本路不以是何投下當差戶計，及軍站人匠、打捕鷹房、斡脫、窯冶諸色人等戶內，每一百戶內取中戶一名充役，與免本戶合著差發，其當戶推到合該差發數目，卻於九十九戶內均攤。

translations.literal: On this route, regardless of which appanage service households, military station craftsmen, hunting falconers, ortoq merchants, kiln workers, and other categories of households, from every hundred households one middle household is taken for service, exempted from that household's proper levies; the proper levy quota for that household is instead spread among the ninety-nine households.
translations.idiomatic: From every hundred households—including appanage, military, craftsman, falconer, merchant, and other categories—one middle household served as archer, exempt from its levies, which were spread over the other ninety-nine.

sentences.zh: 若有失盜，勒令當該弓手，定立三限盤捉，每限一月。

translations.literal: If there is theft, the archer responsible is compelled to set three deadlines for pursuit and capture, each deadline one month.
translations.idiomatic: After theft, the local archer faced three one-month deadlines to make arrests.

sentences.zh: 如限內不獲，其捕盜官，強盜停俸兩月，竊盜一月。

translations.literal: If not captured within the deadline, the bandit-catching official—for robbery has salary suspended two months, for theft one month.
translations.idiomatic: Failure brought salary suspension: two months for robbery cases, one for theft.

sentences.zh: 外據弓手，如一月不獲，強盜決一十七下，竊盜七下；

translations.literal: Besides, for archers, if not captured in one month, robbery—decision seventeen strokes, theft seven strokes;
translations.idiomatic: Archers themselves were beaten if they missed deadlines: seventeen strokes for robbery after one month, seven for theft;

sentences.zh: 兩月不獲，強盜二十七下，竊盜一十七下；

translations.literal: two months not captured, robbery twenty-seven strokes, theft seventeen strokes;
translations.idiomatic: two months: twenty-seven and seventeen strokes respectively;

sentences.zh: 三月不獲者，強盜三十七下，竊盜二十七下。

translations.literal: three months not captured, robbery thirty-seven strokes, theft twenty-seven strokes.
translations.idiomatic: three months: thirty-seven and twenty-seven strokes.

sentences.zh: 如限內獲賊，數及一半者，全免正罪。

translations.literal: If within the deadline bandits are captured numbering half or more, the full principal penalty is entirely remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Capturing half the culprits within the deadline remitted the full penalty.

sentences.zh: 至元三年，省部議：「隨路戶數，多寡不同，兼軍站不該差發，似難均攤。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhiyuan, the Secretariat and ministries deliberated: "Along the routes household numbers differ in more or less, and military stations moreover should not be levied—it seems difficult to spread evenly.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhiyuan, the Secretariat and ministries deliberated: "Along the routes household numbers differ in more or less, and military stations moreover should not be levied—it seems difficult to spread evenly.

sentences.zh: 擬合斟酌京府司縣合用人數，止於本處包銀絲線，並止納包銀戶計內，每一百戶選差中戶一名當役，本戶合當差發稅銀，卻令九十九戶包納。」

translations.literal: It is proposed to suit the manpower needs of capital prefectures and counties, only from wrapped-silver silk households and households paying only wrapped silver on this spot, from every hundred households selecting one middle household for service; that household's proper levy tax silver is instead wrapped by the ninety-nine households."
translations.idiomatic: It is proposed to suit the manpower needs of capital prefectures and counties, only from wrapped-silver silk households and households paying only wrapped silver on this spot, from every hundred households selecting one middle household for service; that household's proper levy tax silver is instead wrapped by the ninety-nine households."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 四年，除上都、中都已有巡軍，其所轄州縣合設弓手，俱於本路包銀等戶選丁多強壯者充，驗各處州縣戶數多寡、驛程緊慢設置，合用器仗，各人自備。

translations.literal: In year 4, besides Shangdu and Zhongdu, which already have patrol troops, archers to be established in subordinate prefectures and counties are all chosen from strong men among wrapped-silver and similar households on this route; verifying each place's household numbers more or less and relay urgency, they are established; required weapons each person supplies himself.
translations.idiomatic: Year 4: except at Shangdu and Zhongdu, other counties chose strong wrapped-silver households as archers with self-supplied arms, scaled to population and relay traffic.

sentences.zh: 八年，御史臺言：「諸路宜選年壯熟閑弓馬之人，以備巡捕之職。

translations.literal: In year 8, the Censorate reported: "Each route should select mature, skilled bow-and-horse men to fill patrol duties.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8, the Censorate reported: "Each route should select mature, skilled bow-and-horse men to fill patrol duties.

sentences.zh: 弓手數少者，亦宜增置。

translations.literal: Where archers are few in number, they should also be increased.
translations.idiomatic: Understaffed posts should be filled.

sentences.zh: 除捕盜防轉，不得別行差占。」

translations.literal: Besides bandit-catching and relay escort, they may not be impressed for other duties."
translations.idiomatic: They were not to be diverted from arrest and escort work."

sentences.zh: 十六年，分大都南北兩城兵馬司，各主捕盜之任。

translations.literal: In year 16, the Dadu North and South City Horse and Infantry Commissions were divided, each presiding over bandit-catching duties.
translations.idiomatic: Year 16: Dadu north and south city Horse and Infantry Commissions were split, each responsible for catching bandits.

sentences.zh: 南城三十二處，弓手一千四百名；

translations.literal: South City thirty-two places, archers one thousand four hundred;
translations.idiomatic: South City: 32 posts, 1,400 archers;

sentences.zh: 北城一十七處，弓手七百九十五名。

translations.literal: North City seventeen places, archers seven hundred ninety-five.
translations.idiomatic: North City: 17 posts, 795 archers.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，省臺官言：「捕賊巡馬，先令執持悶棍以行，賊眾多有弓箭，反致巡軍被傷。

translations.literal: In year 23, Secretariat and censorate officials reported: "Bandit-catching patrol horses were first ordered to carry weighted staves when going out; bandits often had bows and arrows, so that patrol troops were instead wounded.
translations.idiomatic: In year 23, Secretariat and censorate officials reported: "Bandit-catching patrol horses were first ordered to carry weighted staves when going out; bandits often had bows and arrows, so that patrol troops were instead wounded.

sentences.zh: 今議給各路弓箭十副，府州七副，司縣五副，各令置備防盜。」

translations.literal: Now it is deliberated to give each route ten sets of bow and arrow, prefectures and departments seven sets, subprefectures and counties five sets, each ordered to prepare them against theft."
translations.idiomatic: Now it is deliberated to give each route ten sets of bow and arrow, prefectures and departments seven sets, subprefectures and counties five sets, each ordered to prepare them against theft."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 仁宗延祐二年，從江南行御史臺請，以各處弓手人等，往往致害人命，役三年者罷之，還當民役，別於相應戶內補換。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yanyou of Renzong, following the Jiangnan Branch Censorate request, because archers and the like everywhere often cause harm to human life, those who have served three years are dismissed and return to civilian service, and replacements are made from appropriate households.
translations.idiomatic: Yanyou 2 (1315): at the request of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate, because archers and the like in various places had often caused deaths, those who had served three years were dismissed and returned to civilian service, with replacements drawn from suitable households.

sentences.zh: 急遞鋪兵

translations.literal: Urgent Courier Post Runners
translations.idiomatic: Urgent Courier Post Runners

sentences.zh: 古者置郵而傳命，示速也。

translations.literal: In antiquity one established posts to transmit commands, showing speed.
translations.idiomatic: Antiquity set up posts to relay commands—a mark of urgency.

sentences.zh: 元制，設急遞鋪，以達四方文書之往來，其所系至重，其立法蓋可考焉。

translations.literal: Yuan institutions establish urgent courier posts to reach documents coming and going from the four quarters; what they involve is extremely weighty, and their legislation may be examined.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan established urgent courier posts for official correspondence nationwide; the system was weighty and its rules are recorded here.

sentences.zh: 世祖時，自燕京至開平府，復自開平府至京兆，始驗地裏遠近，人數多寡，立急遞站鋪。

translations.literal: In Shizu time, from Yanjing to Kaiping Prefecture, and again from Kaiping Prefecture to Jingzhao, they first verified distance of terrain and numbers of people more or less, and established urgent courier station posts.
translations.idiomatic: Under Shizu, urgent posts were laid out from Yanjing to Kaiping and Kaiping to Jingzhao according to distance and population.

sentences.zh: 每十里或十五里、二十五里，則設一鋪，於各州縣所管民戶及漏籍戶內，簽起鋪兵。

translations.literal: Every ten, fifteen, or twenty-five li, then one post is established; from civilian households and unregistered households under each prefecture and county, post runners are signed up.
translations.idiomatic: Posts were placed every ten, fifteen, or twenty-five li, with runners drafted from registered and unregistered households.

sentences.zh: 中統元年，詔：「隨處官司，設傳遞鋪驛，每鋪置鋪丁五人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhongtong, an edict: "Official offices everywhere shall establish transmission posts; each post shall have five post runners.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongtong 1 (1260): "Every office shall set transmission posts with five runners each.

sentences.zh: 各處縣官，置文簿一道付鋪，遇有轉遞文字，當傳鋪所即註名件到鋪時刻，及所轄轉遞人姓名，置簿，令轉送人取下鋪押字交收時刻還鋪。

translations.literal: County officials everywhere shall place one document register and give it to the post; when there are relayed documents, at the transmitting post immediately record the item, arrival time at the post, and the name of the relay person under jurisdiction, keep a register, and order the relay person to take it down at the post with seal-signature, receipt time, and return to the post.
translations.idiomatic: Each county gave posts a register logging every relayed document, carrier, and handover time with signed receipts.

sentences.zh: 本縣官司時復照刷，稽滯者治罪。

translations.literal: This county office periodically reviews; those who delay are punished.
translations.idiomatic: County offices audited registers and punished delays.

sentences.zh: 其文字，本縣官司絹袋封記，以牌書號。

translations.literal: The documents are sealed in silk bags by this county office, with numbers written on tokens.
translations.idiomatic: Documents were sealed in silk bags and numbered on tokens.

sentences.zh: 其牌長五寸，闊一寸五分，以綠油黃字書號。

translations.literal: The tokens are five cun long and one cun five fen wide, with numbers written in yellow on green oil.
translations.idiomatic: Tokens were five cun by one cun five fen, numbered in yellow on green lacquer.

sentences.zh: 若系邊關急速公事，用匣子封鎖，於上重別題號，及寫某處文字，發遣時刻，以憑照勘遲速。

translations.literal: If they concern urgent frontier business, boxes are used for sealing; on them separate superscriptions are added, and the place and dispatch time of the documents are written, to serve as verification for examining lateness.
translations.idiomatic: Urgent frontier papers used locked boxes marked with destination and dispatch time to check speed.

sentences.zh: 其匣子長一尺，闊四寸，高三寸，用黑油紅字書號。

translations.literal: The boxes are one chi long, four cun wide, three cun high, with numbers in red on black lacquer.
translations.idiomatic: Boxes were one chi by four cun by three cun, numbered in red on black lacquer.

sentences.zh: 已上牌匣俱系營造小尺，上以千字文為號，仍將本管地境、置立鋪驛卓望地名，遞相傳報。」

translations.literal: The above tokens and boxes all use construction small measure; above, the Thousand-Character Classic is used for numbering; still the territory under jurisdiction, place-names of established post relay lookout points, are reported in relay."
translations.idiomatic: The above tokens and boxes all use construction small measure; above, the Thousand-Character Classic is used for numbering; still the territory under jurisdiction, place-names of established post relay lookout points, are reported in relay."

sentences.zh: 鋪兵一晝夜行四百里。

translations.literal: Post runners travel four hundred li in one day and night.
translations.idiomatic: Runners covered four hundred li per day and night.

sentences.zh: 各路總管府委有俸正官一員，每季親行提點。

translations.literal: Each route chief office appoints one salaried regular official, who every quarter personally conducts inspection.
translations.idiomatic: Each route government assigned a salaried officer to inspect quarterly.

sentences.zh: 州縣亦委有俸末職正官，上下半月照刷。

translations.literal: Prefectures and counties also appoint salaried junior regular officials, who review in the first and second half of each month.
translations.idiomatic: Counties assigned junior salaried officers for semimonthly audits.

sentences.zh: 如有怠慢，初犯事輕者笞四十，贖銅，再犯罰俸一月，三犯者決。

translations.literal: If there is negligence, first offense when the matter is light—forty strokes of the cane, commutable by copper; second offense—one month salary fined; third offense—capital punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Negligence: first light offense forty strokes (commutable), second one month salary forfeited, third capital punishment.

sentences.zh: 總管府提點官比總管減一等，仍科三十，初犯贖銅，再犯罰俸半月，三犯者決。

translations.literal: The route government inspection officer is one grade below the route chief, still thirty strokes; first offense commutable by copper, second offense half-month salary fined, third offense capital punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Route inspectors ranked one grade below route chiefs: thirty strokes, then copper ransom, half-month salary fine, then capital punishment.

sentences.zh: 鋪兵鋪司，痛行斷罪。

translations.literal: Post runners and post clerks are severely punished by statute.
translations.idiomatic: Runners and post clerks faced harsh statutory penalties.

sentences.zh: 至元八年，申命州縣官，用心照刷及點視闕少鋪司鋪兵。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Zhiyuan, county officials were again ordered to diligently review and inspect shortages of post clerks and runners.
translations.idiomatic: Zhiyuan 8 (1271): counties were ordered to audit shortages of post clerks and runners.

sentences.zh: 凡有遞轉文字到，鋪司隨即分明附籍，速令當該鋪兵，裹以軟絹包袱，更用油絹卷縛，夾版束系，賫小回歷一本，作急走遞，到下鋪交割附歷訖，於回歷上令鋪司驗到鋪時刻，並文字總計角數，及有無開拆、磨擦損壞，或亂行批寫字樣，如此附寫一行，鋪司畫字，回還。

translations.literal: Whenever relayed documents arrive, the post clerk immediately clearly enters them in the register, swiftly orders the post runner concerned to wrap them in a soft-silk bundle, further bind with oiled silk, fasten with clamp boards, carry a small return register, and run urgently; on reaching the next post and completing delivery of the attached register, on the return register the post clerk verifies arrival time at the post, total corner-count of documents, and whether there was opening, rubbing damage, or scribbled annotations—writing one line thus attached, the post clerk signs, and returns.
translations.idiomatic: Clerks logged arrivals, sent runners with silk-wrapped, board-protected packets and return registers noting time, seal integrity, and damage.

sentences.zh: 若有違犯，易為挨問。

translations.literal: If there are violations, it is easy to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Violations could thus be traced.

sentences.zh: 隨路鋪兵，不許顧人領替，須要本戶少壯人力正身應役。

translations.literal: Post runners along the routes may not hire substitutes; they must personally serve in the prime strength of their own household.
translations.idiomatic: Runners had to serve in person from their own household—no hired substitutes.

sentences.zh: 每鋪安置十二時輪子一枚、紅綽屑一座，並牌額及上司行下、諸路申上鋪歷二本。

translations.literal: Each post is furnished with one twelve-hour wheel, one red signal pile, and signboards and two registers of superior orders and route submissions.
translations.idiomatic: Each post kept a twelve-hour clock, signal beacon, signboard, and two superior/route registers.

sentences.zh: 每遇夜，常明燈燭。

translations.literal: Whenever night comes, lamps and candles are kept bright.
translations.idiomatic: Posts kept lamps burning through the night.

sentences.zh: 其鋪兵每名備夾版、鈴攀各一付，纓槍一，軟絹包袱一，油絹三尺，蓑衣一領，回歷一本。

translations.literal: Each post runner is equipped with clamp boards and bell harness one set each, tasseled spear one, soft-silk bundle one, oiled silk three chi, rain cape one, return register one.
translations.idiomatic: Each runner carried boards, bell harness, spear, silk wraps, oilcloth, rain cape, and a return register.

sentences.zh: 各處往來文字，先用凈檢紙封裹於上，更用厚夾紙印信封皮。

translations.literal: Documents coming and going everywhere are first wrapped in clean inspection paper on top, and further use thick folder-paper sealed envelope covers.
translations.idiomatic: Outgoing mail was wrapped in clean paper and thick sealed envelopes.

sentences.zh: 各路承發文字人吏，每日逐旋發放，及將承發到文字，驗視有無開拆、磨擦損壞、批寫字樣，分朗附簿。

translations.literal: Dispatch clerks of each route daily issue in rotation, and verify incoming dispatches for opening, rubbing damage, or annotations, clearly entering them in registers.
translations.idiomatic: Route dispatch clerks issued mail daily and logged condition of incoming packets.

sentences.zh: 九年，左補闕祖立福合言：「諸路急遞鋪名，不合人情。

translations.literal: In year 9, Remonstrance Official Zu Lifuhe reported: "The name urgent courier post at each route does not accord with human feeling.
translations.idiomatic: Year 9: Remonstrance Official Zu Lifuhe said the name "urgent courier post" was inauspicious.

sentences.zh: 急者急速也，國家設官署名字，必須吉祥者為美，宜更定之。」

translations.literal: Urgent" means haste; when the state establishes office names, they must be auspicious for beauty—it is fitting to change and fix them."
translations.idiomatic: Urgent" means haste; when the state establishes office names, they must be auspicious for beauty—it is fitting to change and fix them."

sentences.zh: 遂更為通遠鋪。

translations.literal: Thereupon they were changed to Far-reaching Posts.
translations.idiomatic: They were renamed Far-reaching Posts.

sentences.zh: 二十年，留守司官言：「初立急遞鋪時，取不能當差貧戶，除其差發充鋪兵，又不敷者，於漏籍戶內貼補。

translations.literal: In year 20, Capital Garrison officials reported: "When urgent courier posts were first established, households unable to bear service were taken, their levies remitted to serve as post runners; when still insufficient, unregistered households were patched in.
translations.idiomatic: In year 20, Capital Garrison officials reported: "When urgent courier posts were first established, households unable to bear service were taken, their levies remitted to serve as post runners; when still insufficient, unregistered households were patched in.

sentences.zh: 今富人規避差發，求充鋪兵，乞擇其富者，令充站戶，站戶之貧者，卻充鋪兵。」

translations.literal: Now the rich evade levies and seek to serve as post runners; we beg to choose the rich and order them to serve as station households, while poor station households instead serve as post runners."
translations.idiomatic: Now the rich evade levies and seek to serve as post runners; we beg to choose the rich and order them to serve as station households, while poor station households instead serve as post runners."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，中書省定議：「近年入遞文字，封緘雜亂，發遣無時，今後省部並諸衙門入遞文字，其常事皆付承發司隨所投下去處，類為一緘。

translations.literal: In year 28, the Secretariat fixed regulations: "In recent years documents entering the relay have sealing in disorder and dispatch without timing; hereafter documents entering the relay from the Secretariat and ministries and all yamens—for routine matters all are given to the dispatch office according to destination, classified into one seal.
translations.idiomatic: In year 28, the Secretariat fixed regulations: "In recent years documents entering the relay have sealing in disorder and dispatch without timing; hereafter documents entering the relay from the Secretariat and ministries and all yamens—for routine matters all are given to the dispatch office according to destination, classified into one seal.

sentences.zh: 如往江淮行省者，凡江淮行省不以是何文字，通為一緘。

translations.literal: For example, those going to the Jiang-Huai Branch Secretariat—all documents for the Jiang-Huai Branch Secretariat, regardless of what documents, are sealed together in one bundle.
translations.idiomatic: All papers for the Jiang-Huai branch, for instance, went in one packet.

sentences.zh: 其他官府同。

translations.literal: Other offices are the same.
translations.idiomatic: Other destinations followed the same rule.

sentences.zh: 省部臺院，凡有急速之事，別置匣子發遣，其匣子入遞，隨到即行。

translations.literal: The Secretariat, ministries, and censorate—for all urgent matters, separate boxes are prepared for dispatch; boxes entering the relay travel as soon as they arrive.
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat, ministries, and censorate urgent business used boxes that moved immediately on arrival.

sentences.zh: 鋪司須能附寫文歷，辨定時刻，鋪兵須壯健善走者，不堪之人，隨即易換。」

translations.literal: Post clerks must be able to attach and write document registers and determine timing; post runners must be sturdy and good at running—unfit persons are immediately replaced."
translations.idiomatic: Clerks had to keep accurate registers and times; runners had to be fit and were replaced if not."

sentences.zh: 三十一年，大都設置總急遞鋪提領所，降九品銅印，設提領三員。

translations.literal: In year 31, Dadu established the Chief Urgent Courier Post Superintendency, issued ninth-rank bronze seals, and established three superintendents.
translations.idiomatic: Year 31: Dadu created a chief urgent-post superintendency with ninth-rank bronze seal and three superintendents.

sentences.zh: 英宗至治三年，各處急遞鋪，每十鋪設一郵長，於州縣籍記司吏內差充，使之專督其事。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhizhi of Yingzong, at urgent courier posts everywhere, for every ten posts one postal chief is established, chosen from registered clerks of prefectures and counties, to specialize in supervising the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Zhizhi 3 (1323): every ten posts received a postal chief from county clerks to supervise service.

sentences.zh: 一歲之內，能盡職者，從優補用；

translations.literal: Within one year, those who fully perform duty receive preferential promotion;
translations.idiomatic: Diligent chiefs were promoted preferentially;

sentences.zh: 不能者，提調官量輕重罪之。

translations.literal: those who cannot, the supervising official punishes according to severity.
translations.idiomatic: negligent ones were punished by their supervisor.

sentences.zh: 凡鋪卒皆腰革帶，懸鈴，持槍，挾雨衣，賫文書以行。

translations.literal: All post runners gird leather belts, suspend bells, hold spears, carry rain capes, and bear documents when traveling.
translations.idiomatic: Runners wore belts and bells, carried spears and rain capes, and bore the documents.

sentences.zh: 夜則持炬火，道狹則車馬者，負荷者，聞鈴避諸旁，夜亦以驚虎狼也。

translations.literal: At night they hold torches; where the road is narrow, those with carts and horses or porters, hearing the bell, yield to the side; at night it also serves to startle tigers and wolves.
translations.idiomatic: At night they carried torches; travelers hearing bells gave way, and the noise also scared off wolves.

sentences.zh: 響及所之鋪，則鋪人出以俟其至。

translations.literal: When the sound reaches the post they are bound for, post personnel come out to await their arrival.
translations.idiomatic: The next post heard the bell and came out to meet them.

sentences.zh: 囊板以護文書不破碎、不襞積，折小漆絹以禦雨雪，不使濡濕之。

translations.literal: Bag boards protect documents from breaking or creasing; folded small lacquered silk wards off rain and snow so they are not soaked.
translations.idiomatic: Board cases and lacquered silk kept documents dry and uncreased.

sentences.zh: 及各鋪得之，則又展轉遞去。

translations.literal: When each post receives them, they are again relayed onward in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Each post forwarded them in turn.

sentences.zh: 鷹房捕獵

translations.literal: Falconry Offices and Hunting
translations.idiomatic: Falconry Offices and Hunting

sentences.zh: 元制，自御位及諸王，皆有昔寶赤，蓋鷹人也。

translations.literal: Yuan institutions: from the imperial throne and all princes, all have šibağči—namely falconers.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yuan law the emperor and every prince maintained šibağči, or falconers.

sentences.zh: 是故捕獵有戶，使之致鮮食以薦宗廟，供天庖，而齒革羽毛，又皆足以備用，此殆不可闕焉者也。

translations.literal: Therefore there are hunting households, causing them to supply fresh food to present at the ancestral temple and supply the celestial kitchen; while teeth, hides, and feathers are all sufficient for use—this is something that can hardly be dispensed with.
translations.idiomatic: Hunting households supplied fresh meat for the ancestral temple and imperial kitchen; hides and feathers served other needs—an indispensable institution.

sentences.zh: 然地有禁，取有時，而違者則罪之。

translations.literal: Yet there are territorial prohibitions and seasons for taking; violators are punished.
translations.idiomatic: Hunting was restricted by region and season, with penalties for violations.

sentences.zh: 冬春之交，天子或親幸近郊，縱鷹隼搏擊，以為遊豫之度，謂之飛放。

translations.literal: Between winter and spring, the Son of Heaven sometimes personally visits the near suburbs, releasing falcons and hawks to strike, as a measure of excursion and pleasure—called flying release.
translations.idiomatic: In late winter or early spring the emperor sometimes hunted near the capital with falcons—called "flying release."

sentences.zh: 故鷹房捕獵，皆有司存。

translations.literal: Therefore falconry offices and hunting all have dedicated offices.
translations.idiomatic: Falconry and hunting had their own administrative offices.

sentences.zh: 而打捕鷹房人戶，多取析居、放良及漏籍孛蘭奚、還俗僧道與凡曠役無賴者，乃招收亡宋舊役等戶為之。

translations.literal: Hunting-falconry office households mostly take divided households, manumitted persons, and unregistered Balx, returned secular monks and Taoists, and idle vagrants without service; they also recruit former Song service households and the like.
translations.idiomatic: Falconry households were drawn from split families, freed slaves, unregistered Balx, secularized clergy, vagrants, and former Song service households.

sentences.zh: 其差發，除納地稅、商稅，依例出軍等六色宣課外，並免其雜泛差役。

translations.literal: Their levies: besides land tax, commercial tax, and the six categories of routine military service and imperial lectures, all miscellaneous levies are exempted.
translations.idiomatic: They paid land and commercial taxes and routine military levies but were exempt from miscellaneous corvées.

sentences.zh: 自太宗乙未年，抄籍分屬御位下及諸王公主駙馬各投下。

translations.literal: From Taizong yiwei year, registers were copied and apportioned to the imperial throne and to each prince, princess, and consort appanage.
translations.idiomatic: From Taizong yiwei year (1235) registers assigned households to the throne and princely appanages.

sentences.zh: 及世祖時，行尚書省嘗重定其籍，厥後永為定制焉。

translations.literal: By Shizu time, the Branch Secretariat once redetermined their registers; thereafter it was permanently fixed as the standard.
